description.narrative:
Institutional and budget support programme for the Decentralised Management of Regional Roads aimed at:
(i) increase Government capacity to plan and manage interventions in the regional road network, (ii) to increase private sector capacity to carry out road works activities and (iii) to provide employment opportunities for rural communities.

Institutional and budget support programme for the Decentralised Management of Regional Roads aimed at (i) increase Government capacity to plan and manage interventions in the regional road network, (ii) to increase private sector capacity to carry out road works activities and (iii) to provide employment opportunities for rural communities.

Institutions- och budgetstöd för "decentraliserad förvaltning av regionala vägar" med målet att i) öka vägförvaltningens kapacitet att planera och förvalta det regionala vägarnätet, ii) öka privata sektorns kapacitet att utföra vägjobb; iii) att skapa arbetstillfällen på landsbygden.

The Project accomplish a substantial part of the Objectives, mainly due to the implementation of the Pilot projects in conjunction with the technical support to those projects and inputs of the two regional works advisors. To this can be added the contributions of the technical assistance in DIMAN (Directorate of Maintenance), the activities within GAT (Gabinete de Assuntos Transversais), and to a lesser degree the support to FME (Federação Moçambicana de Empreiteiros) and some training activities. Considered separately, the road safety component was also successful, albeit without having any clearly established overall goal or strategic objective.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
